scripts.kill-ports: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[4000, 5184, 8001] | ForEach-Object { $pids = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); if ($pids) { Write-Host 'Killing port $_ (PIDs: $pids)'; $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }"
